title: Lieutenant input
description: A JSON object corresponding to a player's request to the LLM: the player's typed message plus a text-only snapshot of the game as the player sees it.

text.description: The only source of new instructions; interpreted together with memory.recent_exchanges.

entities.description: Only things currently visible to the player, plus the player's own structures. Ids must stay stable for the life of the entity.

proximity.description: Undirected proximity graph as an adjacency list. Every ant id and every entity id appears exactly once as a key. Its value lists the ids of all ants and entities within a small fixed distance of it. Links are symmetric: if B is listed under A, then A is listed under B. An empty list means nothing is close by. The graph can be disconnected; a missing link means 'not close', not 'unreachable'.

events.description: Most recent first. The last 10 events, however old.

notes.description: The Lieutenant's own notes, echoed back from its last memory_notes.

recent_exchanges.description: Most recent first. Written by the harness, not the LLM.

summary.description: What the system told the player it understood.

referenced.description: Ants, entities and grid cells that exchange touched.

cell.description: Chess-style grid cell as shown in the GUI: column letter, then row number, i.e. 'A1' to 'J7'.

target.description: An ant id, an entity id, or a grid cell such as 'C5'.

in_loop.description: True when this command is part of a loop that repeats until cancelled.

idle.description: True when the engine reports the ant free AND its queue is empty.

queue.description: Active command first, then queued commands in order. A looping queue shows one full pass. Comes from the sequencer, not the engine.

targeted_by.description: Ants that have this entity as the target of an active or queued command.

detail.description: Free text, e.g. a failure reason.
